data.title: Spinal Geometry Modeling for Metastasis Assessment
data.description: Modeled healthy spinal geometry with a bi-directional quantile regression framework (XGBoost) that predicts normative vertebral volume and inter-centroid distances from demographic and biomarker features. Built a population Statistical Shape Model via Generalized Procrustes Analysis to capture vertebral shape variance, then integrated both modules into a Python library and dashboard for clinician-facing assessment of metastasis-related deformities.

data.title: Multi-task Pancreas Cancer Segmentation and Classification with nnUNetV2
data.description: This project extended nnU-Net v2 with a classification head for joint pancreatic lesion segmentation and subtype classification, exploring shared representations across the two tasks.

data.title: Augmentation of WM811K Silicon Wafer Map Dataset for Error Pattern Detection Training
data.description: This project investigated Wasserstein GANs with gradient penalty as a method for augmenting underrepresented classes in the WM-811K silicon wafer map dataset. I generated synthetic wafer-map images and evaluated whether the augmented data improved defect-pattern classification for imbalanced classes.

data.title: Music Generation Using Autoencoders and Transformer Mixture Distribution Models
data.description: We developed a symbolic-music generation model combining autoencoders with transformer mixture distribution models in TensorFlow. Using sliding-window training on diverse and classical music datasets, we examined melodic tonality, rhythm, and longer-range structure. The model captured tonality more reliably than rhythmic and long-term coherence.
